findings.finding: Widened was ambiguous for a less negative inverted spread.
findings.fix: Specified that the algebraic spread increased 12 bps, preserving all quantities and curve classification.

findings.finding: Buying Silo AI could leave acquisition agreement versus completion unclear.
findings.fix: Specified AMD’s deal to buy Silo AI in the two existing references; no claim of closed acquisition or realized integration benefit was added.

claim_checks.result: Verified Treasury 2Y 4.50%, 10Y 4.20%, -30 bps and twenty-observation -31/-19/+12 bps with inverted bull steepening. Checked every quoted completed 2024-07-11 market value and signed return against its exact instrument/horizon: Russell 2000 index +3.57% differs from IWM +3.59%; Nasdaq 100 -2.24% differs from S&P 500 -0.88%; Tesla 241.03/-8.44%/+41.23% and AMD 181.94/-1.10%/+14.46% retain their own identities. Local Polish PLN tracker/banks, Asian indices, sector ETFs, DXY, credit ETFs, TLT, gold futures 2421.90 USD/oz and GDX 38.09/+12.86% matched correct card lines. Bitcoin/Ether use completed 2024-07-11 UTC daily observations, not equity-session comparisons. No numeric spot FX or split-unit error.

claim_checks.area: Release timing and every cited full title
claim_checks.result: Read all 81 cited full headlines. June US inflation is already released; bank reporting and China loan release remain pending. Delta/AP profit result is separated from Reuters pricing outlook; TCS result retains demand uncertainty; PepsiCo reported quarterly revenue and Conagra projected annual results are distinguished. TSMC revenue is actual sales evidence, not complete earnings. Every ordinary company/political/trade headline fits seven-day eligibility, with macro baseline interpretation kept within the allowed wider window. No later actual data or outcome was used.

claim_checks.area: Session order, corporate actions and roles
claim_checks.result: Nikkei and Australian local closes explicitly precede later US inflation/currency developments and are not called reactions to them. Costco’s July 11 reported fall is a later observable response, distinct from the earlier regular session. MicroStrategy split is announcement only; Broadcom scheduled split changes share units, not enterprise earning power; no post-split price is mixed with pre-split quotes. CFTC chair’s characterization is attributed and does not settle all regulation. Yen intervention remains speculation, not conclusive official action. YouTube remains an internal business, not separately quoted stock.

claim_checks.area: Price versus flow, legal status and actions
claim_checks.result: Russell/Nasdaq relative performance is a price rotation without invented transferred capital or seller identities. IIF portfolio inflows, Indian mutual-fund inflows, Goldman hedge-fund commodity buying and tech-heavy funds retain their distinct scopes. HYG/LQD are ETF prices, not spread or subscriptions. R&F petition and Polish retail searches do not become final legal outcomes. China cash-management tool and short-selling curbs are not private lending or profit growth. Bullish US/real-estate/utilities and selected AMD/Costco calls require financing/retention/commercial confirmation; mixed semiconductors/technology and bearish autos retain coherent reversal conditions.

style_depth.assessment: All 36 blocks have concrete evidence, causal comparisons, contradictory signals and practical triggers. CN connects merchant price wars, batteries, cash management, expected lending, local housing connectivity, tariffs and product localization without claiming a broad recovery. PL compares Pepco, Allegro and Budimex cash requirements with housing yields, wages, governance and actual security financing. The global section distinguishes a one-session price rotation from measured allocations; scenarios need earnings and refinancing confirmation. No major premise or story replacement was required.
style_depth.limits: The review validates the full quoted headline propositions and completed own-card observations; it does not infer article bodies, private trading books, later releases or future operating outcomes.
